practices.guidance: Show a live preview, lens switch and deliberate shutter. Let the person review, retake or delete before accepting.
acceptance: Capture, retake and delete both photo and video samples. Verify only explicitly accepted media reaches processing, with live preview, lens switching and video playback available.

evidence.finding: Native capture review combines these controls for both media types.

practices.guidance: Use a zero-delay shutter for ordinary shots. Offer an explicitly armed GO trigger for group photos and keep tap available.
acceptance: Tap the ordinary shutter and verify no countdown. Arm the group GO trigger and verify it captures only after arming while tap capture remains usable.

evidence.finding: Timed captures made the photographer wait even when ready. The voice option needs on-device recognition and microphone access.

practices.guidance: Put one short framing instruction above the live preview so the person can follow it while composing.
acceptance: Open photo and video capture and verify one short framing instruction stays above the live preview while composing.

evidence.finding: Instructions travel with the capture request into the native viewfinder.

practices.guidance: Collect choices before the input that starts generation. Explain when accepting that input sends it for processing.
acceptance: Change generation choices before accepting input. Verify the displayed processing notice precedes acceptance and the resulting request uses those choices.

evidence.finding: The capture flow uses the chosen style and accepted inputs to start one generation run.

practices.guidance: Start independent media preparation as soon as its inputs are ready. Gate every visible or audible result on the same presentation decision.
acceptance: Trace independent audio and image preparation requests. Verify each starts when its inputs are ready and neither plays nor appears before the common reveal decision.

evidence.finding: The flow test checks that speech and artwork requests both wait for reveal.

practices.guidance: Tie presentation to the portal lifetime. On close, stop owned audio, invalidate late results, and cancel capture work.
acceptance: Close the portal during capture, audio and pending generation. Verify owned audio stops, capture cancels and late replies cannot present results.

evidence.finding: The portal teardown calls the same cancellation path as Stop.

practices.guidance: Keep a generated result available if saving history fails. Report the save error without repeating paid generation.
acceptance: Inject a history-save failure after generation. Verify the result remains available, a save error appears and retrying save makes no generation request.

evidence.finding: A failed table write leaves the result readable and produces one generation call.

practices.guidance: For a multi-step task, show the current choice or primary action. Keep future steps, history and capture management out of its way. On a long-running action, acknowledge the tap immediately with progress in the same area and prevent repeat submission.
acceptance: Walk each step and double-tap the primary action during slow work. Verify one current primary action, immediate progress in its area and one submission.

evidence.finding: The four-step flow test checks that each completed capture gives way to the next action and an early reveal tap immediately shows progress while work continues.

practices.guidance: Each data column toggles ascending/descending. Use raw typed values, stable ties and nulls last. Keep the sort after refresh.
acceptance: Sort numeric, date, text and null fixtures in both directions. Verify raw-value ordering, stable ties, nulls last and retained sort after refresh.

evidence.finding: Each data column toggles ascending/descending. Use raw typed values, stable ties and nulls last. Keep the sort after refresh.

practices.guidance: Sort the complete query before pagination. Keep groups and totals fixed. Action columns declare no comparator. Photo columns use capture time.
practices.rationale: A partial sort gives false order.
acceptance: Sort a multi-page grouped fixture. Verify the global order across page boundaries, fixed groups and totals, absent action comparators and photo capture-time ordering.

evidence.finding: Sort the complete query before pagination. Keep groups and totals fixed. Action columns declare no comparator. Photo columns use capture time.

practices.guidance: Open the shared lightbox on click or Enter. Escape closes. Trap focus and restore the opener. Arrow keys and buttons page.
practices.rationale: Owners need a clear full view.
acceptance: Open an image by click and Enter. Navigate with arrows and buttons, cycle focus inside the viewer, then press Escape and verify focus returns to its opener.

evidence.finding: Open the shared lightbox on click or Enter. Escape closes. Trap focus and restore the opener. Arrow keys and buttons page.

practices.guidance: Page across cursors without duplicate photos. Keep selection by id. Show index or unknown total, caption, load failure and retry. Revoke blob URLs.
acceptance: Traverse overlapping cursor pages and verify unique photo ids and stable selection. Exercise unknown totals, captions and failed-load retry, then verify blob URLs are released.

evidence.finding: Page across cursors without duplicate photos. Keep selection by id. Show index or unknown total, caption, load failure and retry. Revoke blob URLs.

practices.guidance: Use the camera SVG/path and button tokens. Give a name. Disable duplicate capture. No emoji-only control.
practices.rationale: A shared sign makes the action clear.
acceptance: Inspect and activate each capture control. Verify shared camera artwork and button tokens, an accessible name and one capture after repeated activation.

evidence.finding: Use the camera SVG/path and button tokens. Give a name. Disable duplicate capture. No emoji-only control.

practices.guidance: Map source states to taken, queued, processing, processed, failed. Keep failed separate from pending. Show unknown totals as unknown.
acceptance: Feed mixed queued, active, processed and failed items into progress. Verify each displayed count matches source state and missing totals remain unknown.

evidence.finding: Map source states to taken, queued, processing, processed, failed. Keep failed separate from pending. Show unknown totals as unknown.

practices.guidance: Show queued, sent, acknowledged, failed or expired. Mark success only after acknowledgement. Reconcile retries by operation id.
practices.rationale: A queue receipt is not completion.
acceptance: Delay acknowledgement, retry an operation and expire another. Verify success appears only after acknowledgement and retries reconcile to the same operation id.

evidence.finding: Show queued, sent, acknowledged, failed or expired. Mark success only after acknowledgement. Reconcile retries by operation id.

practices.guidance: Render loading, empty, ready, stale, offline, paused, denied and error when applicable. Retry preserves inputs and prior data.
practices.rationale: Missing data differs from no records.
acceptance: Exercise loading, empty, ready, stale, offline, paused, denied and error states where applicable. Retry and verify draft inputs and prior records survive.

evidence.finding: Render loading, empty, ready, stale, offline, paused, denied and error when applicable. Retry preserves inputs and prior data.

practices.guidance: Use shared tokens, type scale, spacing, focus ring and disabled style. Icons keep accessible names. Test light and dark themes.
acceptance: Inspect controls in light and dark themes. Verify shared type, spacing, focus and disabled tokens and an accessible name for each icon.

evidence.finding: Use shared tokens, type scale, spacing, focus ring and disabled style. Icons keep accessible names. Test light and dark themes.

practices.guidance: Use only text needed for operation or structure. No repeated helper prose. Preserve names for assistive tools.
practices.rationale: Brief screens are easier to use.
acceptance: Read each screen and its accessibility tree. Verify every visible text element supports an action, needed information or structure, helper copy appears once and controls retain accessible names.

evidence.finding: Use only text needed for operation or structure. No repeated helper prose. Preserve names for assistive tools.

practices.guidance: Complete each action by keyboard and screen reader. Use semantic roles, labels, focus order, aria-sort and live status. No color-only state.
acceptance: Complete each action using only keyboard, then a screen reader. Verify roles, labels, focus order, sort announcements and live status, including states recognizable without color.

evidence.finding: Complete each action by keyboard and screen reader. Use semantic roles, labels, focus order, aria-sort and live status. No color-only state.

practices.guidance: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast as the test target. Use 44 CSS px web and 48 dp native targets. Respect reduced motion and text scaling.
practices.rationale: Text and controls must remain usable.
acceptance: Measure text and control contrast against WCAG 2.2 AA and target sizes against 44 CSS px web or 48 dp native. Enable reduced motion and enlarged text and verify controls remain usable.

evidence.finding: Meet WCAG 2.2 AA contrast as the test target. Use 44 CSS px web and 48 dp native targets. Respect reduced motion and text scaling.

practices.guidance: At 320, 768 and 1280 CSS px and 200% text, keep actions reachable. Only the table region can scroll horizontally. Preserve focus and draft on redraw.
acceptance: At 320, 768 and 1280 CSS px with 200% text, reach every action. Verify horizontal overflow stays inside the table and redraw preserves focus and a draft.

evidence.finding: At 320, 768 and 1280 CSS px and 200% text, keep actions reachable. Only the table region can scroll horizontally. Preserve focus and draft on redraw.

practices.guidance: Use declared typed tables and photo refs. Follow every data cursor. Export includes all accessible rows and source-photo links. Stateless applets need no table.
acceptance: Discover declared typed records and photo references, then exhaust all cursors. Compare export ids and source-photo links with every accessible stored row; for a stateless applet verify no durable records are written.

evidence.finding: Use declared typed tables and photo refs. Follow every data cursor. Export includes all accessible rows and source-photo links. Stateless applets need no table.

practices.guidance: Use expected revision, stable ids and idempotency keys. Reject stale writes. Use undo or explicit confirmation for destructive actions. Never run an automatic account reset.
practices.rationale: Owners must not lose newer work.
acceptance: Submit a stale revision and retry a write with the same idempotency key. Verify rejection of stale edits, stable ids and one mutation. Exercise destructive confirmation or undo and verify no account reset runs.

evidence.finding: Use expected revision, stable ids and idempotency keys. Reject stale writes. Use undo or explicit confirmation for destructive actions. Never run an automatic account reset.

practices.guidance: Preserve per-owner and per-instance grants. Keep secrets write-only. Redact logs. Test revoke, deletion, retention and cross-owner denial.
practices.rationale: Private data needs its access boundary.
acceptance: Using isolated test owners and instances, verify cross-owner denial, revocation, deletion and retention behavior. Inspect API responses and logs for secret redaction and write-only handling.

evidence.finding: Preserve per-owner and per-instance grants. Keep secrets write-only. Redact logs. Test revoke, deletion, retention and cross-owner denial.

practices.guidance: Expose authenticated reads and applicable create/update/clear/delete/rotate operations. Share UI validation. Publish discovery and HTTP/MCP contracts.
practices.rationale: An owner agent needs equivalent control.
acceptance: For every editable field or dataset, discover and round-trip its supported read and mutation operations through authenticated HTTP/MCP. Verify equivalent invalid inputs receive the same validation as the UI.

evidence.finding: Expose authenticated reads and applicable create/update/clear/delete/rotate operations. Share UI validation. Publish discovery and HTTP/MCP contracts.

practices.guidance: Discover actual capability, permission and readiness. Keep OS and owner consent. Never add a grant, paid call or upload during inspection.
acceptance: Inspect capabilities with missing permission, unavailable hardware and exhausted budget. Verify readiness is accurate, consent is retained and inspection produces no grant, paid request or upload.

evidence.finding: Discover actual capability, permission and readiness. Keep OS and owner consent. Never add a grant, paid call or upload during inspection.

practices.guidance: Read development snapshot. Preserve baseline, settings, stable ids, intentional removals and journal. Use three-way merge. Block conflicts before activation.
acceptance: Modify a fixture with personal settings, removed elements and upstream changes. Verify three-way merge preserves ancestry, stable ids, journal and intent, and conflicts block activation.

evidence.finding: Read development snapshot. Preserve baseline, settings, stable ids, intentional removals and journal. Use three-way merge. Block conflicts before activation.

practices.guidance: Negotiate catalog and component versions. Reject unsupported changes before mutation. Keep the working revision. Respect paused and detached copies.
practices.applies_when: Any new runtime or catalog requirement
practices.rationale: Older devices need a safe path.
acceptance: Offer unsupported component and catalog versions to an older-runtime fixture. Verify refusal before mutation, retention of the working revision and preservation of paused or detached state.

evidence.finding: Negotiate catalog and component versions. Reject unsupported changes before mutation. Keep the working revision. Respect paused and detached copies.

practices.guidance: Dry-run migration on a copy. Test interrupted apply and recovery. Keep records and photos. Do not promise rollback until restore tests pass.
practices.rationale: A failed update must preserve records.
acceptance: Dry-run migration on a copy containing records and photos, interrupt apply and resume recovery. Compare retained ids and photos; claim rollback only after a tested restore matches the original.

evidence.finding: Dry-run migration on a copy. Test interrupted apply and recovery. Keep records and photos. Do not promise rollback until restore tests pass.

practices.guidance: Bound fetches, image decode, retries and polling. Abort on instance switch. Ignore stale replies. Test large data and slow networks.
practices.applies_when: Lists, photos, polling or network calls
acceptance: Load a large collection on a slow network, trigger failures and switch instances mid-request. Verify configured concurrency, decode, retry and polling limits, aborted old work and ignored stale replies.

evidence.finding: Bound fetches, image decode, retries and polling. Abort on instance switch. Ignore stale replies. Test large data and slow networks.

practices.guidance: Record catalog review: added, changed or no-new-practice with reason. Name affected rule ids and changed surfaces. No empty attestation.
practices.rationale: New useful defaults need a home.
acceptance: Inspect a creation and a modification payload. Verify the catalog review names affected ids and surfaces with a concrete reason and a valid decision; additions or changes include a proposal.

evidence.finding: Record catalog review: added, changed or no-new-practice with reason. Name affected rule ids and changed surfaces. No empty attestation.

practices.guidance: Derive applicability from package and code. Emit pass, fail, exception, not-applicable, unverified or legacy-debt. Bind evidence to artifact and runtime hashes.
practices.rationale: A claim alone proves no behavior.
acceptance: Evaluate a candidate and inspect applicable-rule results and artifact/runtime hashes. Verify failed, unverified and legacy outcomes remain distinct and agent assertions cannot produce a trusted behavioral pass.

evidence.finding: Derive applicability from package and code. Emit pass, fail, exception, not-applicable, unverified or legacy-debt. Bind evidence to artifact and runtime hashes.
